verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client. Multi-channel inbox support is a fair question for inbox products, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only a unified inbox across email providers such as Gmail and Outlook, and nothing about SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat channels.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
